fusions.name: Thrown at the Gallop
fusions.desc: Throws a short javelin that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 12% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Trampling Front
fusions.desc: Charges a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 13 blunt damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spurred Forward
fusions.desc: A burst of speed that carries you 6 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Pace
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%.
